title: Cache Persistence
description: Persist React Query cache across page reloads and browser sessions for offline-capable applications.

data.text: By default, React Query cache lives in memory. When the user refreshes the page, all cached data is lost. Persistence plugins save the cache to localStorage or IndexedDB, allowing the app to show cached data immediately on reload, even offline.

items: localStorage: Simple key-value storage, synchronous, 5-10MB limit.
IndexedDB: Larger capacity, asynchronous, better for large datasets.
data.title: Storage Options
Persisting cache with localStorage

data.text: Never persist sensitive data. localStorage is unencrypted and accessible to any script on the page. Use secure storage for auth tokens.
data.title: Security

data.text: On app load, the persister hydrates the query cache with stored data. Components can render immediately with cached data while React Query validates freshness in the background.

data.title: Cache Persistence Key Points
points: Persistence survives page reloads and browser restarts.
localStorage is simple but limited in size.
Never persist sensitive data in plain storage.
data.takeaway: Cache persistence dramatically improves perceived performance and enables offline-first experiences.
